3074.title: Compact settings actions lose ownership context
3074.rootCauseOneLine: One generic compact column header is used for heading-owned icons, while fleet and changelog actions are mounted inside containers that imply the wrong owner.

prReviews.verdict: ADDRESSES ROOT CAUSE — static review only
prReviews.topFinding: The diff adds caller-specific placement policies for the small heading action, fleet toolbar, and changelog card; the branch was not executed.

3074.proposedFix: Use an opt-in inline header action for small controls, render fleet actions above machine cards, and keep changelog controls inside the release card.
3074.caveats: The direct visual reproduction used headless Chrome rather than Safari. PR 3076 was reviewed statically and was not checked out or executed.
